name: The Griffon's Nest
texts: The griffon isn't here at the moment...
But it can't be played with...

Waaah! A waterfall?
If I don't make a good jump...Wait a minute?! Not a waterfall!
I have to jump that?!Oh, this can't be!
If I can't make a good jump...This can't be... a waterfall! This can't be... a waterfall!
If I don't make a great jump...Oh, a waterfall!
Now I really have to jump right!This can't be happening- a waterfall!
I'm going to have to really jump!Hey!
What am I supposed to do now!Waaah!
If I fall down there, I'm dead!Ohhh, a waterfall!
I have to jump that?!Oh no! Not a waterfall?!
Am I supposed to jump it?Blast, a waterfall!
Looks like I'm going to have to jump.Curse it, a waterfall!
I have to jump it...A waterfall!
Hmmm, I'll have to jump to the rocks on the other side...No, no, no! A waterfall!
Well, I'm going to have to jump......A waterfall?
...I need to jump to the rocks on the other side......A waterfall, of course.
...I have to jump to the rocks on the other side....It looks like nobody's here......There doesn't seem to be anyone here......There's nobody here. I wonder where they've gone?...There's nobody here. I wonder where they've gone?Hmmm... it looks like they've been run off......Well, I'll be... it looks like they've been driven off...Nobody home? Mr. Bird... where are you?Is there anyone here? ...Mr. Bird, where are you?Blast, they've fled...Curses, it looks as if they've been run off......There's nobody here....There's nobody here.They got scared and fled... well, naturally...There's nobody here. Actually, that's just as I expected....Nobody here......Nobody here...I don't think I'm too welcome here...I don't seem to be welcome here...What now? I don't seem to be too popular here...What now? I don't seem to be too popular here...It doesn't seem to be in a very good mood.I'm obviously not welcome here.It's getting angry...It's starting to get angry...Hey, I don't feel too welcome...Well it doesn't look too happy...I'm not too welcome here.I'm not very welcome here.Oh quit trying to scare me.It seems to be in a bad mood...It looks mad.It looks mad.t8|,
